title: Add read isolation support to Isolated Storage Management
summary: Isolated Storage Management codeunit now provides Get method overloads that accept an IsolationLevel parameter, allowing explicit control over read isolation for both Text and SecretText values.
key_points: Adds Get overloads accepting IsolationLevel for Text values
Adds Get overloads accepting IsolationLevel for SecretText values
Preserves existing key-length validation and output-clearing behavior
Delegates to platform IsolatedStorage.Get without new storage logic
No breaking changes or compatibility risks
